subject: Bootleg And Suffer
author: ichienkai
body:
Wow guys!  I have been watching this afternoons "battle" mmm strong word maybe? Between you two love Birds and yeah wow...

My first thought was Judge not, lest you be judged (to SUFFER's comment) and obviously because Bootleg is a great friend of mine i simply wanted to defend him.  1st question is have you guys raced together yet?? If not why not?? I know SUFFER jumped in a room we were in with Xandu and Zombietron but couldnt join or we were disbanding the room or something but apart from that YOU TWO should race someday soon - please make it my room!!

I get your further point SUFFER that Boot can vent anger/frustration (again misplaced strong words) towards other people and getting a taste of your own medicine is sometimes required to set the boundries but we (his friends) race a LOT together and with other people and meet new friends all the time: and know the ways of the Bootleg - he can race SUFFER, very well i might add. He has not lost any ability to race he is just bored of the game, thats why he parks up and ruins laptimes/races for other people and yup dispite what we write here or on other Burnout forums/websites: we don't mind - it's entertaining.... spices things up.  He has even convinced me that rank does not matter and i know as soon as i get one of my higher ranking tags and create a room he will ruin my ranked races but i do it.

I can guarantee you when Boot retires for the evening and leaves the room a deathly silence occurs and everyone goes "Damn its so quiet" You can picture the tumbleweeds drifting across the empty plains raising sand in their wake.

I am not an intelligent person SUFFER and i am not a writer but to judge someones writing style like you have is a bit harsh - many other people find Boots diatribe (may i borrow your word please - i like it) funny and have said so - basically you dont have to read what he writes if he bores you... you may have standards but many others dont and enjoy his writing style which, you have to admit is unique and what is a blog for really??

Well thats enough from me, i havnt got time to sit here for hours thinking about what i'm going to write about - your blogs seem pretty free flowing anyway SUFFER, it does not read like you are sat there for ages pondering the direction in which they are going.  Please both of you guys dont take any of this the wrong way, please both continue your blogs as they are both the bigger part of the blog system Xan And Zombie have in place on this site and PLEASE be nice. Life is too short - right i'm off to play my Guitar - one day i WILL be as good as Andy Mckee.....! Whatever.  If you havnt heard of Andy Mckee check him out on youtube - do it - do it now - he will change you...  Peace

By the way my GF does indeed have a lot of love for the Bootleg and you know what... he knows it too the B*****d!

 

Women and cats will do as they please, and men and dogs should relax and get used to the idea.
